chunks.title: Host lesson: Writing a professional email — Subject lines
chunks.text: A professional email starts with a clear subject line. Keep the subject line under eight words and say what you need, for example: Request: meeting on Tuesday. Avoid vague subject lines such as Hello or Question, because busy readers skip them.

chunks.title: Host lesson: Writing a professional email — Closing
chunks.text: End a professional email with one clear next step and a polite closing, such as Kind regards, followed by your full name. Reply to work emails within one working day, even if only to say when you will answer in full.
